hook: Tailwind CSS just dropped a new update to smooth out some common dev headaches.
body: Version v4.3.2 brings two useful fixes. You can now use bare spacing values for grid utilities like `auto-rows-12`, allowing for more flexible styling. Crucially, a frustrating crash in `--watch` mode for Windows users, when `@source` directories didn't exist, has been squashed. This means more stable and reliable development, especially on Windows.
